title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout dates, licensing, default availability and controls are supported by Microsoft's supplied notice and documentation. It accurately distinguishes the Android rollout announcement from Learn's preview wording and identifies the remaining documentation gaps.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans Facilitator notes for unscheduled, in-person discussions in Teams Rooms on Android.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is expanding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Facilitator already captures notes in scheduled Teams meetings.
claims.quote: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Users start in-person AI notes by selecting Take notes on the Teams Rooms console.
claims.quote: During an in-person meeting, users can start AI-powered notes by selecting the Take notes button on the Teams Rooms console.

claims.claim: Facilitator captures real-time notes, decisions and action items from in-person meetings.
claims.quote: This enhancement allows teams meeting in a physical room to capture real-time notes, decisions, and action items—without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Notes appear on the front-of-room display or touch board during the meeting.
claims.quote: Notes appear on the front-of-room display or touch board during the meeting

claims.claim: The roadmap says shared notes are available through meeting recap.
claims.quote: Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Notes are deleted automatically if no participant is added during the session using Access notes.
claims.quote: If no participant was added during the note-taking session via Access notes, notes are deleted automatically.

claims.claim: No meeting data remains stored or cached on the room device after the meeting ends.
claims.quote: No meeting data is stored or cached on the Teams Rooms device after the meeting ends.

claims.claim: Participants with access can view and edit notes afterwards through meeting recap in the meeting chat on Teams desktop.
claims.quote: After the meeting, notes can be viewed and edited by participants with access via the meeting recap in the meeting chat on the Teams desktop client.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice requires adding a work account with Access notes to obtain access.
claims.quote: Access to notes requires adding your work account using the Access notes button on the Teams Rooms console.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Learn calls the save action Save notes and says to add participants' names in its dialog for later access.
claims.quote: At the end of the session, select Save notes and ensure participants’ names are added in the dialog pop-up so they can access the notes and transcript later on their personal devices.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn says unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.
claims.quote: Unsaved notes are deleted after the session ends.

claims.claim: Facilitator turns on transcription during the meeting.
claims.quote: Facilitator only turns on transcription during the meeting.

claims.claim: Facilitator does not record the meeting.
claims.quote: The meeting won't be recorded.

claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: MC1307888 was updated on 24 September 2026 to change its timeline.
claims.quote: Updated September 24, 2026: We have updated the timeline.

claims.claim: The notice announces Worldwide and GCC rollout beginning in early November 2026.
claims.quote: Worldwide and GCC: We will begin rolling out in early November 2026

claims.claim: The notice expects rollout completion by early December 2026.
claims.quote: expect to complete by early December 2026

claims.claim: The previously announced rollout completion was mid-November.
claims.quote: early December 2026 (previously mid-November)

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn labels in-person room note-taking preview, whereas the notice announces General Availability.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.claim: Learn's FAQ projects Facilitator for Teams Rooms on Android in a future release.
claims.quote: Facilitator is available on Teams Rooms on Windows and is projected to release on Teams Rooms on Android in a future release.

claims.claim: The Android release notes list a Facilitator offline/ad hoc note-taking preview under build 1449/1.0.96.2025126202 (May 2025).
claims.quote:
1449/1.0.96.2025126202 (May 2025)
Introduced in this update:
1. Preview of Facilitator agent note taking in Rooms for offline/ad hoc discussions.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature is available automatically once licensing and prerequisite configuration are met, supporting defaultState on.
claims.quote: The feature is available automatically once licensing and prerequisite configurations are met.

claims.claim: No additional admin enablement is required beyond existing settings.
claims.quote: No additional admin enablement is required beyond existing settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed into AI summaries, decisions and action items.
claims.quote: Meeting audio and transcription data are processed to generate AI-powered meeting notes, including summaries, decisions, and action items.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Generated notes are stored in tenant-owned SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Meeting notes generated by Facilitator are stored in tenant‑owned SharePoint Embedded storage.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn describes the stored AI notes as a Loop file in the tenant's SharePoint Embedded storage.
claims.quote: Facilitator stores AI-generated notes as a Loop file in SharePoint Embedded storage that belongs to the tenant and users who saved the notes can access it later.

claims.claim: Learn says the stored room notes are treated as meeting transcript data.
claims.quote: The data is treated as meeting transcript data.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's Facilitator-for-meetings limitations say notes do not inherit the meeting's sensitivity label.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.

claims.claim: Learn says Prevent copy and paste is not applied to Facilitator responses or notes in meetings.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn says meeting watermarks are not applied to Facilitator responses or notes in meetings.
claims.quote: Meeting settings like Prevent copy and paste and Watermarks aren't applied to Facilitator's responses or AI-generated notes in meetings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Facilitator notes for meetings are not automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited documentation does not establish whether the Facilitator-for-meetings limitations also apply to unscheduled in-person room notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator in person Teams Rooms sensitivity labels watermark eDiscovery notes. Read facilitator-teams (limits under Facilitator for meetings), facilitator-teams-rooms and watermark-meeting-content-video results; none expressly extends those limits to unscheduled room notes.

claims.claim: Only participants who add their names at the beginning and have enrolled profiles are identified and attributed.
claims.quote: Currently, only participants who add their names at the beginning of the meeting session will be identified and attributed, provided that they have enrolled their profiles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn's in-person setup requires enabling the Facilitator app for the room resource account.
claims.quote: Enable Facilitator app for the room resource account in the Teams admin center.

claims.claim: If app availability is scoped to People and Groups, it must include the room resource account.
claims.quote: If app availability is set to Everyone, the room account is included. If availability is scoped to People and Groups, include the Teams Rooms resource account.

claims.claim: Muting the room microphone prevents Facilitator or transcription from capturing content.
claims.quote: You can mute the microphone in the room to ensure Facilitator or transcription doesn't capture any content.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Pro Management portal Show Take notes button on the home screen setting is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Show Take notes button on the home screen. The default setting is enabled.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: In-person note-taking is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro, supporting licensing model included.
claims.quote: Facilitator in Teams Rooms for in-person note-taking is in preview and is currently included with Teams Rooms Pro.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: A Teams Rooms Pro licence is required on each room resource account used for the experience.
claims.quote: Pre-requisite: Assign a Teams Rooms Pro license to each resource account you have for your Teams Rooms devices

claims.claim: Learn's in-person setup steps do not list a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Pre-requisite: Assign a Teams Rooms Pro license to each resource account you have for your Teams Rooms devices

claims.claim: The cited pages document no feature-specific meter, credit rate or usage charge as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Facilitator in person notes pricing usage meter credits licensing. Read facilitator-teams-rooms and search excerpts for rooms-licensing and rooms-plan; no feature-specific meter, credit rate or usage charge was stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The feature pages cited here do not publish the price of Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Facilitator in person notes pricing usage meter credits licensing. Read facilitator-teams-rooms, facilitator-teams and Loop admin configuration; no Teams Rooms Pro price appears there. The statement is limited to these pages, not Microsoft's pricing site.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited feature documentation does not publish what the licensing model or feature cost would become if changed before final release.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms in-person licensing final release; Teams Rooms Pro Facilitator in person notes pricing usage meter credits licensing. Read facilitator-teams-rooms and licensing search results; the feature page warns of possible change without specifying a future model or price.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Risk assessment: Change & support; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn warns that the preview experience and licensing model may change before final release.
claims.quote: Preview features might not be complete, and the experience and licensing model may change before final release.

claims.claim: The Loop admin policy page says storage for Loop files, including those in SharePoint Embedded, counts against the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Loop components and their integrations are powered by `.loop` files (earlier releases created `.fluid` files), stored in OneDrive, SharePoint, or SharePoint Embedded. Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: The notice asks administrators to ensure Facilitator is enabled in the tenant.
claims.quote: Ensure Facilitator is enabled in your tenant.

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; controls[2].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The notice asks administrators to verify IsLoopEnabled and IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled.
claims.quote: Verify Loop components are enabled:- IsLoopEnabled- IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled

claims.where: Scope: Prerequisites; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The notice requires meeting transcription enabled in Teams meeting policies.
claims.quote: Ensure meeting transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The room-level control is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: No API for the Pro Management portal Take notes setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Show Take notes button API Teams Rooms; Teams Rooms Pro Management Take notes Facilitator PowerShell Graph API configuration setting; Facilitator Teams Rooms Set- Graph. Read room setup, Facilitator setup and XML management search excerpts; no operation sets this control.

claims.claim: General meeting transcription is configured in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the specified meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: The Teams Loop properties shown in the row have no documented admin UI equivalent.
claims.quote: Searched: IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin UI Teams settings SharePoint PowerShell. Read Loop admin configuration and its search excerpts: Teams properties use SharePoint PowerShell; the documented admin-center checkbox controls Loop workspaces, not these properties.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true; Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables the listed Teams Loop experiences.
claims.quote: [Teams-only] `Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true`, `Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true`

claims.claim: The two Loop SharePoint properties apply to the entire tenant and cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Learn distinguishes the SharePoint properties for Teams integration from Cloud Policy controls for other Loop integrations.
claims.quote:
Loop in Outlook, OneNote, Whiteboard, or New Calendar | Cloud Policy: Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop
Loop in Teams chat, channels, and meeting notes | SharePoint PowerShell: Set-SPOTenant commands

claims.claim: Learn documents Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Actions menu > Allow or Block.
claims.quote:
In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps.
In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator.
Select Facilitator from the app list.
In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Learn says Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default. However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The room setup links to general meeting transcription policy documentation without identifying which policy unscheduled in-person notes use.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator in person notes room resource account meeting transcription policy missing prerequisites button. Read room setup, transcription guidance and release-note search results; no passage specifies policy resolution for unscheduled in-person notes.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the Take notes button's behaviour when a prerequisite is missing.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Take notes prerequisites missing button; Teams Rooms Facilitator in person notes room resource account meeting transcription policy missing prerequisites button. Read room setup and experience sections and search results; no missing-prerequisite button behaviour is specified.

claims.claim: Saved notes can be reached from the meeting chat's Recap tab on Teams desktop.
claims.quote: To access notes after the meeting, navigate to the Teams meeting chat titled “Meeting with [conference room name].” At the top of the meeting chat, select the Recap tab, and then select Notes to find the AI-generated notes and transcript.
